units.previous_finding: At the explanatory comment about comparable, the two consecutive Greek comment lines read ο οποίος ικανοποιεί τον περιορισμό comparable / επομένως μπορούμε να χρησιμοποιήσουμε εδώ τον τελεστή ==. There is no punctuation between comparable and επομένως, forming an awkward run-on sentence at a central explanation of the constraint. Repair the sentence boundary while preserving comparable, T, v, x and == and the original technical meaning.

The comment Η append λειτουργεί και με τμήματα πινάκων nil is an unnatural and potentially misleading rendering of nil slices: the trailing nil does not clearly qualify the slice value and could be read as modifying underlying arrays. Clarify that append accepts a nil slice, not a nil array; retain append and nil as protected Go terms and do not alter any code.
